blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Commission on Appointments (CA) on Friday confirmed the nomination of Renato Ner Dueñas Jr. as Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to Negara Brunei Darussalam, along with the appointments and nominations of 35 generals, flag officers, and senior officers of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP). Dueñas, a Chief of Mission, Class II, was nominated as the country’s envoy to Brunei after the Committee on Foreign Affairs recommended his nomination for approval by the CA plenary. He was approved by the plenary without objection. READ: CA elects new officers, committee leaders Thursday Without objection, the CA plenary also […]...
